en.title: Maximum Cumulative Memory Score over Any Reading Order
en.description:
Read all chapters in any order; after reading each chapter, you score the sum of the memory values of all chapters read so far. Find the maximum possible sum of all these scores. Memory values may be negative.

The standard I/O, examples, and judging were written independently by CSWork; conventions marked as this site's are not presented as original source constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..100000), and the second line contains n memory values (−1000..1000).
en.explanation: Example 1: reading in the order 5, 4, 3 gives scores 5, 9, 12, for a total of 26. Example 2: reading −1 first and then −2 gives scores −1, −3, for a total of −4, which is larger than the −5 of the other order. Example 3: the total is 0.
hints: Read in descending order of memory value and add up the prefix sum at each step.
